name: Orb · Dispersion
description: A cut-glass orb whose own shell does the dispersing: rays grazing the turbulence-warped sphere ride it for a long arc so the limb glows, interior sheets split into rainbow striations through per-channel palette phases, and an analytic silhouette keeps the edge knife-sharp (WebGL). Ported from Orbkit shdr-01 — shader by XorDev, non-commercial.
